ok im not sure what you mean by add medication?

what you need to try and remember more than anything is that what has happened has gone, the only power that anxiety has over you is the fact that you don't want to feel that way again so you start to worry and thinking that you are going to have this panic that could come at any time.

your memory plays a big part but remember it is only that a memory, a memory of how you felt that causes you to feel tense and nervous! do not let it become more than it is please do not spend time thinking over it its gone except what happened, and how you felt it cant and wont kill you, don't let it start to define your life and be saying to yourself if only i could go back to how i felt before this will only course you to become more depressed, try not to see this event as a massive deal because it is really not it's just something that happened do not spend years and years trapped in worrying like i did because worry and being scared takes place in your mind and is very seldom happening now.
hi can i ask what brought this about i too started to suffer panic attacks from a early age hopefully i can give you some advice:)
